docs.title: go-xslt
docs.text:
Pure-Go XSLT.

go-xslt is a pure-Go (CGO_ENABLED=0) XSLT processor: it applies XSL transformations over a pure-Go XML DOM (go-nokogiri), with no libxslt and no cgo.

Everything is pure Go (CGO_ENABLED=0), standard-library-first, and cross-compiles to every 64-bit Go target. Licensed BSD-3-Clause.
